On Ammo Finder/Normal Ammo Brick Pickup:
Grants an additional 3-5% of your Maximum Reserves to #element.

Guarantees at least 1 more Ammo on Pickups.

By default, normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Maximum Reserves.

var element = <arc/>Arc Weapons matching the Ammo Type

On Ammo Brick Pickups:
Grants an additional 3-5% of your Total Reserves to #element.

Guarantees at least 1 more Ammo on Pickups compared to without the mod. Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.

By default, normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves.

var element = <arc/>Arc Weapons matching the Ammo Type

On Ammo Brick Pickups in PVE game modes:
Grants an additional 3-5% of your Total Reserves to #element.

Guarantees at least 1 more Ammo on Pickups compared to without the mod. Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.

By default, normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves.

var element = <arc/>Arc Weapons matching the Ammo Type

On Ammo Brick Pickups in PVE game modes:
Grants an additional 1% of your Total Reserves to #element. This is increased to 10% with #exceptions.

Always rounds up to the nearest whole number. Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.

By default, normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves.

var element = <arc/>Arc Weapons matching the Ammo Type

var exceptions = Trace Rifles, Swords, and Grand Overture
